name: EOSV WP-MVP-0002 Verification Bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosv/verify-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  EOS_ACTOR: chatgpt

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout bootstrap branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Enter exact final-tree baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="8d93a6ee04ab8bc06d35b5b07e83d51c2b328f40"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          git reset --hard "$BASE_SHA"
          test ! -e .github/workflows/eosv-verify-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap.yml
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Fresh Rust verification on merged implementation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
          rustup override set 1.95.0
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features

      - name: Capture first-class EOSV WP evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0002 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0004
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Assert EOSV invariants
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv, json

          wp = Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md').read_text()
          assert '**Status:** VERIFYING' in wp, wp.splitlines()[:10]

          with Path('.eos/work-packets.tsv').open(newline='') as fh:
              rows = {row['id']: row for row in csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter='\t')}
          assert rows['WP-MVP-0002']['status'] == 'VERIFYING', rows['WP-MVP-0002']

          with Path('.eos/evidence.tsv').open(newline='') as fh:
              evidence = list(csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter='\t'))
          current = [r for r in evidence if r.get('target') == 'WP-MVP-0002' and r.get('status') != 'SUPERSEDED']
          assert len(current) == 3, current
          assert {r['validator'] for r in current} == {'eos-integrity','repository','execution-acceptance'}, current
          assert all(r['execution'] == 'EXEC-0004' for r in current), current
          assert next(r for r in current if r['validator']=='eos-integrity')['result'] == 'PASSED', current
          assert next(r for r in current if r['validator']=='repository')['result'] in {'PASSED','SKIPPED'}, current
          acceptance = next(r for r in current if r['validator']=='execution-acceptance')
          assert acceptance['result'] == 'PASSED', acceptance
          assert all(r['status'] == 'VALIDATED' for r in current), current

          events = [json.loads(line) for line in Path('.eos/events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
          transitions = [e for e in events if e.get('target')=='WP-MVP-0002' and e.get('action')=='validate' and e.get('event_type')=='STATE_TRANSITION']
          assert transitions, 'missing WP-MVP-0002 validation lifecycle transition'
          assert transitions[-1]['from_state']=='IN_PROGRESS' and transitions[-1]['to_state']=='VERIFYING', transitions[-1]
          assert transitions[-1]['commit']=='8d93a6ee04ab8bc06d35b5b07e83d51c2b328f40', transitions[-1]
          PY

          if git diff --name-only | grep -E '^(crates/|src/|.*\.rs$|product/|architecture/|specifications/|engineering/work-cycles/|engineering/increments/|\.github/workflows/)'; then
            echo 'Unexpected product or governing-authority change detected.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          git status --short
          git diff --stat
          git diff -- engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md
          git diff -- .eos/evidence.tsv

      - name: Commit prove stable and publish isolated EOSV ref
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          FINAL_BRANCH="eosv/verify-wp-mvp-0002"
          git config user.name 'PMB CI'
          git config user.email 'ci@pmb.test'
          git add -A
          if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '^(crates/|src/|.*\.rs$|product/|architecture/|specifications/|engineering/work-cycles/|engineering/increments/|\.github/workflows/)'; then
            echo 'Unexpected out-of-scope staged change detected.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          git diff --cached --stat
          git commit -m 'chore(eosv): verify WP-MVP-0002'

          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "8d93a6ee04ab8bc06d35b5b07e83d51c2b328f40"

          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$FINAL_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Final publication branch already exists: $FINAL_BRANCH" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$FINAL_BRANCH"
